The Suns host the Denver Nuggets in this Emirates NBA Cup West Group A game, their fourth of the 2026-27 season. Phoenix is 1-2 overall (1-0 at home, 0-2 on the road), on a one-game losing streak, and sits 2nd in the Pacific, 1.5 games back and 11th in the West. Denver is also 1-2 (1-1 at home, 0-1 on the road) and on a one-game losing streak, sitting 4th in the Northwest, 2.5 games back and 10th in the West.

Mark Williams is out with a shoulder injury (surgery), and Oso Ighodaro is day-to-day with an oblique strain and a game-time decision for Phoenix. Denver is without Alpha Diallo (out, personal), Cameron Johnson (out, ankle sprain), Julian Strawther (out, knee sprain) and Spencer Jones (out, hamstring).

The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, after the Suns lost 0-3 in the 2025-26 season series. Their last meeting, a regular season game in Phoenix on March 24, 2026, ended with the Suns losing 125-123.
